2608.02163.title: From Simple QA to Deep Research: A Verifiable Benchmark Constructed through Iterative Task Evolution
2608.02163.paper_summary: Deep research benchmarks require expert-level tasks and reliable evaluation grounded in task-specific knowledge. Existing benchmarks rely heavily on expert authoring or pre-existing human-authored materials, while fully automatic construction struggles to ensure consistent and traceable verification. To address this gap, we introduce a verifiable benchmark of 500 deep research tasks spanning 31 topics and 10 major categories, with three query forms designed to probe complementary capabilities required for deep research. The benchmark is constructed automatically using an iterative Explorer-Formalizer-Challenger pipeline that progressively transforms simple questions into deep research tasks. Each task is represented as a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of atomic steps and associated checkpoints, enabling the query, DAG, and rubrics to evolve together in a controlled manner. Experiments demonstrate that the benchmark clearly discriminates among models and query types, while its fact-grounded pointwise rubrics enable fine-grained, human-aligned, and stable evaluation. Our data, implementation, and results are publicly available.
2608.02163.paper_summary_zh: 深度研究基準需要專家級的任務和基於特定任務知識的可靠評估。現有的基準在很大程度上依賴專家創作或現有的人類創作材料，而完全自動化的構建則難以確保一致且可追溯的驗證。為了解決這一空白，我們介紹了一個可驗證的基準，涵蓋500個深度研究任務，涵蓋31個主題和10個主要類別，並設計了三種查詢形式，以探測深度研究所需的互補能力。該基準是通過一個迭代的Explorer-Formalizer-Challenger流程自動構建的，該流程逐步將簡單問題轉化為深度研究任務。每個任務被表示為一個原子步驟和相關檢查點的有向無環圖（DAG），使查詢、DAG和評分標準能夠以受控的方式共同演變。實驗表明，該基準能夠清楚地區分模型和查詢類型，而其基於事實的逐點評分標準則實現了細緻、人類對齊和穩定的評估。我們的數據、實施和結果均為公開可用。
